 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The FSU Seminoles have a chance to pick up the biggest win of the Luke Loucks era on Tuesday. The No. 1 Florida Gators are coming to Tallahassee for a rivalry meeting, and the Donald L. Tucker Center is already sold out.
 Both teams are undefeated to start the season, with FSU crushing the FAMU Rattlers and Troy Trojans. Florida handled the Miami Hurricanes to start the year before dominating the North Florida Ospreys.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Florida is one of the most experienced teams in the country, relying on an elite front court that features Rueben Chinyelu, Alex Condon, and Thomas Haugh. The trip will be a tough test for FSU freshman Marcis Ponder, who was named the ACC Rookie of the Week after recording a double-double in each of the first two games of his career.
 The Seminoles will likely need another efficient night from Sebastian Rancik and Shon Abaev. Rancik is leading them in scoring at 21.5 points per game, and Abaev can take over a game with his impressive shotmaking. Loucks is looking to get FSU back to the NCAA Tournament, and Florida gives them an early chance to test themselves against a national title contender.

 FSU leads 10-7 at second media timeout
 06:21 PM ET, November 10 2026, JD McCarthy 
 Florida State's defense has held Florida scoreless for 4:17, with Florida missing their last six shots. They will have a chance to cut into the lead after the timeout, with Isaiah Brown set to shoot a pair of free throws. FSU is shooting 5-14 from the floor, with Anthony Robinson II leading the way with four.
 FSU trails Florida 7-6 at first media timeout
 06:10 PM ET, November 10 2026, JD McCarthy 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Seminoles have their first deficit of the season, trailing 7-6 with 15:28 to go in the first half. FSU's defense has forced Florida to take six three-points, with the Gators making just one, but they have turned three offensive rebounds into four second-chance points.
 FSU is 3-9 from the floor to start, with all six of their points coming in the paint. Shon Abaev has missed their only two three-pointers.
 FSU is attacking the basket early
 06:06 PM ET, November 10 2026, JD McCarthy 
 The Seminoles are trailing for the first time this season, with Florida taking a 5-4 lead early in the game. FSU's offense has attacked the basket to begin, with their first four shots coming at the rim, with them making two.
